scope: Independent review of all visual/evaluation session additions and their integration boundaries

findings.title: Local edit-prompt rejection consumes a submission and becomes unknown cost exposure
findings.trigger: A valid parent has 40 bounded material/critical findings with descriptions of roughly 480 characters. The immutable edit bundle includes all mandatory regression targets, even when the user selects only one finding. Its worker metadata is below 128 KiB but its rendered provider prompt exceeds 16,000 characters.
findings.defect: HTTPImageProvider.preflight validates dimensions, capabilities, funding and input pixels but does not build/check the full edit prompt. The worker commits authorization and increments the original call/submission counters before submit performs this pure local length check. The resulting ImageFundingLocked is converted to ProviderFailure(image_operation_unknown) with may_have_sent true.
findings.impact: A provably unsent edit consumes one of four image submissions, one of two attempts for its logical edit step and request allowance. Its conservative reservation remains unknown, reducing available budget and presenting misleading unknown-provider usage. Retrying the same valid feedback deterministically repeats this failure.
findings.validation: Actual execute_image_operation with temporary SQLite, normal immutable reviews and HTTPImageProvider using injected MockTransport: worker persisted the failure, HTTP request count 0, operation status failed/error image_operation_unknown, ledger status unknown, reserved_usd 0.40, settled_usd null, request_count 1, submission_count 1 and edit:version_2 step_calls 1. Separate adapter probe confirms preflight accepts the same class of request and submit rejects locally.
findings.fix_direction: Use one pure bounded serializer/validator for both preflight and submit, including the exact approved bundle. Reject or provide a lossless supported context strategy before committing authorization. Preserve an explicit unsent classification for local adapter validation failures rather than mapping them to unknown sent exposure.
caveats: The probe establishes unknown conservative exposure, not an actual provider charge or overspend.
Only temporary synthetic state and mocked HTTP were used.
findings.relation_to_prior_audit: Fresh boundary case introduced/exposed by the EVAL-01 exact-bundle fix; the original finding-transmission bug is fixed on ordinary bounded examples.

findings.title: Accepted ancestor and child findings exceed the next-edit feedback envelope
findings.trigger: V1 receives two valid independent critiques of 20 critical findings each. V2 receives two valid critiques, each explicitly marks all 40 parent targets persistent and adds 20 new critical findings. Each critique respects the existing 20-finding/60-regression-check schema.
findings.defect: The service faithfully appends the 40 unresolved ancestor findings to the 40 new V2 findings, then rejects the resulting 80-entry context against a separate global 40-finding cap. Accepted per-stage contracts are not closed under the new ancestry-retention operation. The improvement endpoint calls the raising helper outside any VisualLimit handler.
findings.impact: Both independent pixel coverage and regression completeness are true for V2, and the existing session remains readable, but the user cannot request the V3 edit needed to address those defects. On the improvement route after a valid preflight, the uncaught VisualLimit produces a server error instead of a declared context limitation/recovery path.
findings.validation: Fresh temporary SQLite probe commits actual scoped reviews/receipts, a native child version, full persistent regression checks and 40 new critical findings. V2 reports coverage_complete true, regression_complete true and 80 unresolved blockers; design_view remains readable. version_feedback_findings(V2) raises VisualLimit. API line 357 and the application exception handlers were inspected to establish the uncaught route behavior.
findings.fix_direction: Make cumulative obligation bounds consistent with every accepted per-version review and append-only supplement, or support a deterministic bounded context that preserves all unresolved obligations. Validate future serviceability before accepting an edit/review combination, and return an explicit recoverable domain limitation for unavoidable limits. Do not silently truncate inherited blockers.
caveats: No obligation was silently discarded; this is a blocked workflow and exception handling defect.
The 500 conclusion is source-confirmed after preflight; this probe did not run a complete authenticated HTTP preflight/improve transaction.
The native child commit avoids provider traffic; immutable lineage/review validation uses the production service.
findings.relation_to_prior_audit: Fresh cumulative-bound case for the EVAL-03 ancestry-retention fix. The ordinary missing-regression and single-persistent-ancestor tests pass.

findings.title: Blinded study artifacts omit definitions of valid cited prior claims
findings.trigger: A proposal introduces a valid assumption claim. A later synthesis legitimately references its durable claim ID from the supplied claims/allowed-reference context without repeating the proposition.
findings.defect: The public artifact citation-closure builder indexes only successful stage IDs (proposal/provider IDs, synthesis, audit). It does not index the durable claim IDs introduced by the newly shared claim protocol, so a prior-claim reference does not bring its definition or originating contribution into anonymous_contribution_sources.
findings.impact: The retained blinded recommendation contains an unresolvable claim ID. Human reviewers cannot inspect what proposition was relied on or the supporting chain in the artifact they are asked to grade. This can alter usefulness/critical-defect grades and invalidates an assumption that citation closure is complete for the new claim protocol.
findings.validation: Actual FundedStudyRunner independent_review execution with existing approved synthetic fixtures and injected HTTP adapters; all edited responses pass validate_output. Three proposals introduce UNIQUE_PRIOR_ASSUMPTION_MEANING; synthesis and audit cite a real prior durable claim. The run completes in five requests. public_text contains the cited claim ID but not its proposition, and has no anonymous_contribution_sources.
findings.fix_direction: Compute public transitive closure over the exact scoped claim definitions and their reference edges as well as peer stage references; include bounded, anonymous claim/source records with stable mappings. Preserve the source/evidence status and provider blinding, and test references to ancestor claims without copied proposition text.
caveats: Private stage_records retain the claim definition; this is incomplete reviewer export, not loss of raw records.
A model that happens to repeat every proposition in its synthesis may conceal the defect; that repetition is not required by the valid reference contract.
The synthetic assumption is unverified and is not asserted as factual truth.
findings.relation_to_prior_audit: Fresh reference-closure boundary of the EVAL-02 study claim-context fix; no prior finding specifically about durable claim reference closure was identified in the algorithm-audit findings.

algorithm_inventory.name: Immutable selected-feedback bundle
algorithm_inventory.review: Parent pixel/brief hashes, selected full finding content, address/decline choices, locked requirements and digest reach actual provider prompt. Hash mismatch/parent mismatch rejected. O(serialized findings). Ordinary path passes; SESSION-EVAL-01 bounds remain.

algorithm_inventory.name: Mandatory regression target derivation
algorithm_inventory.review: Prior material/critical observations and hash-identified locked requirements become independent review targets; addressed parent finding excluded. O(findings + requirements); 40 input findings.

algorithm_inventory.name: Regression coverage and blocker reduction
algorithm_inventory.review: Latest per-provider checks; at least two eligible critics must explicitly resolve each target. Missing/uncertain/declined/persistent/regressed states remain blockers. Distinct from pixel quorum. O(targets * critics).

algorithm_inventory.name: Unresolved ancestor carry-forward
algorithm_inventory.review: Recursively retain unresolved prior obligations across saved versions even without repeated new findings. Bounded ancestry, cycle/scope rejection. SESSION-EVAL-02 exposes cumulative cardinality mismatch.

algorithm_inventory.name: Immutable original review and supplements
algorithm_inventory.review: Original DesignReview remains unchanged; one append-only supplement per critic; stable provenance IDs; original inference role/counters retained. O(saved session operations + reviews), bounded but full scan.

algorithm_inventory.name: Independent critic completion and queueing
algorithm_inventory.review: Two distinct configured non-generator providers; original/supplement target union; pending operation deduplication; exhausted logical roles cannot create new allowance. O(reviews + operations).

algorithm_inventory.name: Exact-pixel review provenance
algorithm_inventory.review: Server receipt binds SHA256 of bytes/views/transforms/current and comparison parent. No same-round peer reviews in initial packets; scoped previous finding IDs. O(pixel bytes + findings). Receipts prove delivery, not semantic inspection.

algorithm_inventory.name: Review and view schema contracts
algorithm_inventory.review: 20 findings/critic, 60 regression checks, duplicate local finding/target rejection, 500-character finding descriptions; views expose separate pixel coverage/regression completeness/blockers. These per-stage bounds do not ensure cumulative closure.

algorithm_inventory.name: Visual admission and command snapshot
algorithm_inventory.review: Preflight binds revision/hash/configuration/prices/pending work; improvement targets latest immutable version and requires regression review. Selected choices resolve to saved findings. SESSION-EVAL-02 has uncaught domain-limit error.

algorithm_inventory.name: Worker packet reconstruction and preauthorization checks
algorithm_inventory.review: Reconstruct exact bundle from scoped saved parent reviews, compare saved bundle, include current/parent pixels for critics, cap metadata at 128KiB. Pure provider preflight before reservation. SESSION-EVAL-01 shows serializer bound is later.

algorithm_inventory.name: Image authorization and settlement
algorithm_inventory.review: Original call/submission ceilings and finish holds shared by supplements. Unknown usage retains conservative reservation. SESSION-EVAL-01 proves a local unsent exception is misclassified unknown.

algorithm_inventory.name: Shared substantive case fingerprinting
algorithm_inventory.review: Remove display IDs/titles/revisions, map evidence identities by content, sort known unordered options/requirements/cost/snapshots; preserve amount/text and arbitrary sequence order. Reject exact normalized aliases/development overlap; cannot prove paraphrase independence.

algorithm_inventory.name: Release and visual case denominator validation
algorithm_inventory.review: Reuses normalized case identities including decision-relevant evidence/rubric context. Release exact48 and visual>=12 matched case constraints; no automatic release. Human provenance review required for independence.

algorithm_inventory.name: Blinded original review/adjudication binding
algorithm_inventory.review: Retained immutable output/configuration/task identities and approved reviewer roster when supplied; originals retained; missing/failed/insufficient reviews stay not useful; adjudication does not erase original critical signals. O(outputs + grades).

algorithm_inventory.name: Funded shared protocol and claim requests
algorithm_inventory.review: Shared version/hash and next-stage policy, proposal barrier, scoped durable claims, typed material issue reducer, frozen same-round context, conditional revisions, one reserved correction/re-audit. Fixed preconfirmed evidence/journal executor remains explicitly scoped. Existing synthetic traces pass.

algorithm_inventory.name: Blinded study citation closure
algorithm_inventory.review: Peer contribution closure anonymizes stage references and transitive stage dependencies; SESSION-EVAL-03 shows durable claims omitted. Graph work scans output structure/stage IDs until fixed point.

algorithm_inventory.name: Correction finish-pool budget
algorithm_inventory.review: One optional correction can reserve synthesis plus independent audit within original 24-call/time/currency ceilings; repeated correction reservation denied. Exact Decimal/resource ledger, unknown exposure retained.

algorithm_inventory.name: Paired primary efficacy estimator
algorithm_inventory.review: Planned16 primary tasks remain denominator; paired wins/losses/ties; seeded task-cluster percentile bootstrap; exact McNemar only independent clusters. Bounded1000..20000 resamples; O(resamples*tasks). No automatic phase pass.

algorithm_inventory.name: Critical-risk uncertainty and repeated diagnostics
algorithm_inventory.review: Critical differences withheld until both original review sets complete. Exact one-sided zero-event bound only under independent-case assumption; repeats retained as diagnostics, not independent denominator. Bootstrap precision limited by small/unrepresentative clusters.

algorithm_inventory.name: Observed cost and admitted latency denominator
algorithm_inventory.review: Bind trial/workflow/configuration/dataset/status; finite bounded Decimal cost; reported + unknown = conservative exposure; original failed admissions retained in observed timing denominator. Missing planned observations explicitly exposed. First-useful metric conservatively requires completed mandatory work; pre-existing behavior, not raised as fresh regression.

validation.result: Four independent synthetic probes pass assertions; completed with zero real provider HTTP calls.

validation.command: PYTHONPATH=backend/src:backend/tests:. uv run pytest -q backend/tests/test_algorithm_evaluation_visual_fixes.py backend/tests/test_visual_review_regressions.py backend/tests/test_study_runner.py backend/tests/test_exhaustive_runtime_study.py backend/tests/test_deep_runtime_study.py backend/tests/test_evaluation.py backend/tests/test_release_evaluation.py backend/tests/test_visual_evaluation.py backend/tests/test_audit_evaluation.py backend/tests/test_image_provider.py backend/tests/test_image_worker.py

limits: No paid empirical model-quality runs or human grading; tests establish implementation behavior, not accuracy superiority.
No production services, configuration or existing source/test files changed.
Root audit covers frontend and artifact evidence integrity; sibling audits cover runtime and evidence semantics.
Substantive hashing does not prove case independence, and distinct providers do not prove independent epistemic errors.
The full authenticated HTTP reproduction for ancestry overflow was not executed; route exception propagation was established from production source and absence of a VisualLimit handler.
